release_format: Original-format face-anonymized sequence PKLs with JSON manifests and original frozen index PKLs

source_policy.preservation: Byte-identical copy; no modality removal or image re-encoding
source_policy.face_review: Uses supplied face-anonymized source; exhaustive independent visual review is not asserted

image_frames.precision_note: Depth and infrared are existing encoded 8-bit images, not raw 16-bit sensor measurements

frozen_indexes.preservation: Original relative paths and byte-identical PKLs

completion_indexes.preservation: Original relative paths and byte-identical PKLs; separate from the nine pose indexes

completion_training_cache.sequence_arrays: Shared with cache/pose-v1/raw/; original images remain in full PKLs
completion_training_cache.supervision: Online 16 radius-0.05m sphere samples per joint plus aligned valid radar points; default target has 384 points

training_cache.source: Installed full anonymized sequence PKLs and original frozen index PKLs
training_cache.format: Numeric NPZ with allow_pickle=false and UTF-8 JSON metadata; not standalone NPY files

sequence.images_and_timestamps: Remain in full source PKLs, not duplicated into numeric training arrays

split.sequence_index: Position in split JSON sequence_ids; alias resolved by cache manifest.json

training_cache.configuration_identity: configs/<sha256>.json records point count, input channels, sequence length, seed, split and saved normalization metadata
training_cache.normalization: Imported training-only feature_stats; Doppler clipped to +/-clip_abs then divided by clip_abs; SNR clipped to [clip_min,clip_max] then mapped to [0,1]
training_cache.sampling: Original NumPy random-start greedy farthest-point sampling at runtime; zero padding; no newly frozen stochastic sampling policy

security: Installer verifies hashes without unpickling; cache generation loads trusted dataset PKLs only
